prompts.prompt: Wide photograph of a dimly lit Stockholm-style concert hall with arched brick ceilings, a full band silhouetted on stage under cool blue and warm amber spotlights, a sparse audience seated at small candle-lit tables in the foreground.

Atmospheric photograph of an empty Stockholm jazz club interior, worn leather booths, exposed wooden beams, brass instruments resting on a small stage under soft pendant lighting, a bartender polishing a glass behind the counter.

Extreme close-up of a guitarist's calloused left hand pressing a chord on a worn rosewood fretboard, shallow depth of field showing silver tuning pegs, warm amber stage light catching the strings' shimmer.
